text.p: Tenerife of Spain beat Schalke of Germany 1-0 (halftime 1-0) in their UEFA Cup semifinal first leg on Tuesday.
Red Cards: Angel Vivar Dorado (T) 55, Marcelo Ojeda (T) 75
